first.rationale: Provisional choice: simplify onboarding because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates shorter onboarding improves completion and time-to-value. Verify promotional pricing as the strongest context-specific alternative and activation messaging as another direct response. Measure qualified-revenue and retention guardrails because the inherited onboarding evidence establishes early adoption lift, not long-term revenue impact.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified prior produced a 13% completion lift, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current declines with the best evidence of sustainable value. Activation messaging remains credible but had a smaller retention gain, while promotional pricing is rejected because its 18% qualified-revenue lift came with 12% lower 30-day retention and failure through renewal. Track qualified revenue and longer-term retention because the onboarding evidence does not yet establish durable revenue impact beyond 30 days.
